ranking_protocol: held-out observed interactions only; top-k per user; relevant if overall_rating >= threshold; macro precision/recall; zero-relevance users contribute zero AP/MRR
fcp_protocol: pooled comparable pairs within users, ties excluded
limitations: Paper does not specify K, relevance threshold or exact baseline hyperparameters.
Some test users/items may be unseen in training. Neural models use unknown-ID embedding; Surprise falls back to algorithm estimates.
Metrics may differ from paper due to data source, ranking candidate universe, seed and library versions.
Validation subset is drawn from training fold; stage-2 network trains on ground-truth training criteria.
Final predictions are clipped to [1,5] for evaluation; the network output layer itself is unclipped ReLU (paper Eq. 4/9).
